Privacy Policy

Last updated: 11 November 2026

Maharashtra Dry Cleaners uses this billing website to create and retain dry-cleaning bills and, when requested, send a bill PDF through WhatsApp.

Information we use

We use the customer name, WhatsApp phone number, address details, bill period, service items, quantities, prices and bill total entered while creating a bill.

How we use it

We use this information to prepare bills, keep business records, answer billing questions and send the requested bill to the customer on WhatsApp.

Service providers

Billing data is stored with Supabase. When a bill is sent through WhatsApp, the customer phone number and bill PDF are sent to Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform for delivery.

Sharing and retention

We do not sell customer information. We keep bill records only as needed for business and legal record-keeping purposes.

Your choices

For questions, corrections or to stop receiving WhatsApp bills, contact Maharashtra Dry Cleaners at 9930156507 or 8291119298.

Updates

We may update this policy when our billing or messaging service changes. The current version is always available on this page.
